query: I have an AAY ration card, am I entitled to receive free food grains?
positive:
Scheme: Anna Bhagya Scheme (Karnataka) | Category: Food Security | Section: Overview
Anna Bhagya is a Karnataka food-security guarantee scheme that provides free foodgrains to below-poverty-line families to ensure nutritional security.

Benefits: Free rice / foodgrain entitlement per person per month to eligible BPL (Antyodaya and Priority Household) families; where rice is short-supplied, an equivalent cash transfer is made.
